question: A particle starts at the origin and travels along the positive $x$-axis. For the first one second, its speed is $1$ m/sec. Thereafter, its speed at any time $t$ is at most $(9/10)$-th of its speed at time $t-1$. Then

options.A: the particle reaches any point $x>0$ at some finite time;
options.C: the particle may or may not reach $x=9$ but it will never reach $x=10$;
options.D: nothing of the above nature can be predicted without knowing the exact speed.
